verses.english: Numbered Discourses 10.169
17. With Jānussoṇi
With Saṅgārava

verses.pali: Atha kho saṅgāravo brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṁ sammodi.
verses.english: Then Saṅgārava the brahmin went up to the Buddha, and exchanged greetings with him.

verses.pali: Sammodanīyaṁ kathaṁ sāraṇīyaṁ vītisāretvā ekamantaṁ nisīdi. Ekamantaṁ nisinno kho saṅgāravo brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: When the greetings and polite conversation were over, he sat down to one side and said to the Buddha:

verses.pali: “Kiṁ nu kho, bho gotama, orimaṁ tīraṁ, kiṁ pārimaṁ tīran”ti?
verses.english: “Worthy Gotama, what is the near shore? And what is the far shore?”

verses.pali: “Pāṇātipāto kho, brāhmaṇa, orimaṁ tīraṁ, pāṇātipātā veramaṇī pārimaṁ tīraṁ.
verses.english: “Killing living creatures is the near shore, brahmin, and not killing living creatures is the far shore.

verses.pali: Adinnādānaṁ kho, brāhmaṇa, orimaṁ tīraṁ, adinnādānā veramaṇī pārimaṁ tīraṁ.
verses.english: Stealing is the near shore, and not stealing is the far shore.

verses.pali: Kāmesumicchācāro orimaṁ tīraṁ, kāmesumicchācārā veramaṇī pārimaṁ tīraṁ.
verses.english: Sexual misconduct is the near shore, and avoiding sexual misconduct is the far shore.

verses.pali: Musāvādo orimaṁ tīraṁ, musāvādā veramaṇī pārimaṁ tīraṁ.
verses.english: Lying is the near shore, and not lying is the far shore.

verses.pali: Pisuṇā vācā orimaṁ tīraṁ, pisuṇāya vācāya veramaṇī pārimaṁ tīraṁ.
verses.english: Backbiting is the near shore, and avoiding backbiting is the far shore.

verses.pali: Pharusā vācā orimaṁ tīraṁ, pharusāya vācāya veramaṇī pārimaṁ tīraṁ.
verses.english: Harsh speech is the near shore, and avoiding harsh speech is the far shore.

verses.pali: Samphappalāpo orimaṁ tīraṁ, samphappalāpā veramaṇī pārimaṁ tīraṁ.
verses.english: Talking nonsense is the near shore, and avoiding talking nonsense is the far shore.

verses.pali: Abhijjhā orimaṁ tīraṁ, anabhijjhā pārimaṁ tīraṁ.
verses.english: Covetousness is the near shore, and contentment is the far shore.

verses.pali: Byāpādo orimaṁ tīraṁ, abyāpādo pārimaṁ tīraṁ.
verses.english: Ill will is the near shore, and good will is the far shore.

verses.pali: Micchādiṭṭhi orimaṁ tīraṁ, sammādiṭṭhi pārimaṁ tīraṁ.
verses.english: Wrong view is the near shore, and right view is the far shore.

verses.pali: Idaṁ kho, brāhmaṇa, orimaṁ tīraṁ, idaṁ pārimaṁ tīranti.
verses.english: This is the near shore, and this is the far shore.
Few are those among humans
who cross to the far shore.
The rest just run
around on the near shore.
When the teaching is well explained,
those who practice accordingly
are the ones who will cross over
Death’s dominion so hard to pass.
Rid of dark qualities,
an astute person should develop the bright.
Leaving home behind
for the seclusion so hard to enjoy,
try to find satisfaction there,
having left behind sensual pleasures.
Owning nothing, an astute person
should cleanse themselves of mental corruptions.
And those whose minds are rightly developed
in the awakening factors;
letting go of attachments,
they delight in not grasping.
With defilements ended, brilliant,
they are quenched in this world.”
